column1: # Provisional game profile of Resident Evil 4 (Switch, base game v0 + update v131072), SDK 5.4.0, NVN through nn::gfx. Written from a survey of the game files with
# dm/games/profile_guess.py; the game has not been booted with it. Every key marked "guess" follows a rule or a sibling profile and is not measured. README.md beside this file.
# guess: a third-person game that uses both sticks and the D-pad; nothing in the files decides it
# The update changes only main (the base game's is 8ceaf0d2ae48a9350c60d38a43119325); subsdk0 and sdk are the base game's files. The display version was not read (the import keeps no control data)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk0, sdk. subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie: main takes 29 functions from it (movie::Decoder, H.264, for the CRI movies), none of which the host supplies itself.
# main also imports eight glslc* functions that no module of the game defines (there is no GLSLC module); whether it ever calls them is not known
# the file types that are big or already compressed (profile_guess.py's rule)
# guess (profile_guess.py's rule, not measured): the NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0), so there is no virtual address memory, and main imports nn::os::SetMemoryHeapSize:
# the 4 GB layout of such games (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region), with the hardware pool
# no mem_used: the rewritten modules are 49 MB (main 28.9, sdk 12.5, subsdk0 7.4), under the default 64 MB of used memory
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py: 207 BNSH files embedded in main, none in the RomFS) ----
# PEANUTS begin: picture shapes, untested candidates (aspect_plan, dm/host/aspect_plan.h): Game settings > Display > Fill
# NOT SEEN ON A DEVICE. Every place the ? pack's main has the width,height pairs in data (a scan of the code on 2026-11-21, no community patch behind them):
# the 3D view may follow the screen, the 2D layer may not, or the game may draw wrongly or not start with Fill. Fit is unchanged. Take out the
# rows that prove wrong, and aspect_plan_untested once a device has shown the rest right (the note says what was seen).
